project_name: Apex & Blade - Barber Shop Booking & Management System
archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS HYBRID (Dark Charcoal & Warm Aged Brass)
emotional_tone: Craftsmanship, Prestige, Tactile Elegance, Seamless Precision

theme.mode: Dark Luxury (Primary) with high contrast Bone White typography and Aged Brass accents

headings.font_family: Cormorant Garamond, Playfair Display, Georgia, serif
headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#F4F1EA] leading-[1.1]
headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#F4F1EA]

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (2-3x default padding) with explicit asymmetric Bento Grids for marketing and high-density functional grids for admin controls.
spacing_and_layout.bento_marketing: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8
spacing_and_layout.admin_dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 lg:gap-6

surface_and_materials.glass_header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0D0D0E]/80 border-b border-[#D4AF37]/20 sticky top-0 z-50
surface_and_materials.luxury_card: bg-[#141416] border border-[#26262A] hover:border-[#D4AF37]/40 rounded-xl transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.35)]
surface_and_materials.featured_card_glow: relative bg-[#1C1C20] border border-[#D4AF37]/50 rounded-xl shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(212,175,55,0.15)]

customer_facing: Navigation Header with Live Booking Status Indicator & Sticky CTA Button
Hero Section with Dual Action CTAs ('Book Appointment' & 'Explore Services')
Quick Stats Ribbon (e.g. 4.9★ Rating, 12K+ Cuts, Master Barbers, Hot Towel Included)
Services Catalog Grid with Pricing, Duration, Add-on selector, and Direct Book trigger
Interactive Gallery Showcase with Filter Tabs & Lightbox Modal
Multi-Step Seamless Booking Flow (Modal/Drawer or Dedicated Page):
- Step 2: Select Hairstyle Inspiration or Enter Custom Notes/Requests
- Step 3: Choose Preferred Barber & Select Date + Live Time Slot
- Step 4: Customer Details & Payment Method Selection (Pay at Shop vs Card)
- Step 5: Confirmation with Booking Reference, QR Code/Summary, Calendar File Add
Customer Quick Rebooking & Account Management Modal
Contact, Business Hours, Interactive Location Map & Parking Info Section
admin_dashboard: Key Metrics Cards (Today's Bookings, Estimated Revenue, Top Hairstyles, Active Barbers)
Bookings Management Table with Filters (Status: Pending/Confirmed/Completed/Cancelled) & Quick Actions
Manual Booking Creation Modal for Walk-ins or Phone Reservations
Services & Add-ons CRUD Manager (Title, Description, Price, Duration, Category)
Hairstyle & Gallery Portfolio Manager (Image URL, Title, Category Tag, Visibility)
Blackout Dates & Shop Closure Scheduler (Holiday/Maintenance lock)
Shop Business Settings (Opening Hours, Barber Shifts, Shop Address, Contact Info)

testing_attributes.requirement: ALL interactive components, buttons, navigation links, form inputs, status badges, price items, and table rows MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use dark luxury theme (#0D0D0E base, #D4AF37 brass accent) throughout customer and admin views.
Ensure the booking flow is zero-friction, minimal steps, and available both as a direct modal/drawer and as a dedicated route/tab.
Include fast 'Book Now' sticky CTA buttons on mobile and desktop navigation headers.
Use Lucide-React icons for UI indicators (Calendar, Clock, Scissors, Check, Shield, User, DollarSign, MapPin, Phone, Star).
All API state management (services, gallery photos, blackout dates, bookings, business settings) must use React state with smooth fallback mock data or backend integration.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, headers, or overlays — always apply crisp dark backdrop blur or solid elevated surface.
Include sonner toast notifications for booking confirmations, admin actions, and errors.
